readings.quarter_identity: a quarter is (stock id, basis, quarter index) of pit's snapshot.quarters (latest revision before D, scale screen applied, an income statement reported); figures are looked up by quarter index L - k in basis b*
readings.window_complete: each of the quarters L* - 7 .. L* is a row of snapshot.quarters in that basis whose revenue, profit_normalised and ebitda are all present
readings.v1_basis_missing: a stock with known quarters that pit.fundamentals leaves out (only consolidated rows, fewer than four in its TTM) is on the standalone basis for C4 with no quarter in it: no L, every figure missing, E5 fires
readings.run: consecutive known quarters (rows, whatever they report) in b* ending at L, as pit.fundamentals' consec_quarters counts them
readings.missing_quarters: quarters L - 0 .. L - 8 with no row in b* (YYYY-MM of the quarter's last month), separated by ';'
readings.write_back_flag: true when any of FC_0..FC_3 that exists is below -1e7; the ICR state is unknown first if TTM_EBIT or FC+ is missing
readings.icr_value: TTM_EBIT / FC+ written only in the state 'icr'
readings.down_flags_record: DOWN0 and DOWN1 are written true or false when known and empty when unknown; an unknown flag counts as false in F6 and E4
readings.de_record: D/E is written only for a usable balance sheet with equity above zero; a usable balance sheet with equity <= 0 fails F3 and fires E3
readings.close_record: close is the raw close C, close_adj = C x pit.cumulative_factor (D's share basis); market cap = close_adj x shares
readings.ticker: the symbol traded at D: pit's member ticker (its last EQ/BE row before D); for a non-member the ticker of its close C; else the identity spell at the day before D
readings.owners_profit: consolidated basis only: P_k x f_k with f_k = (eps_basic_k x N_k) / profit_continuing_k of the consolidated row, N_k the standalone row's shares_implied for the same quarter; f_k outside (0, 1.5] or missing -> 1
readings.shares_reference: median over up to four earlier known quarters (standalone first) of shares_implied / pit.cumulative_factor at the filing's broadcast date, i.e. carried to D's share basis; shares_ref_over_n = that median / shares
readings.untested_trim: 'trim' is untested when the holding's P/E is unknown
readings.sell_order: at a session, sales fill first in stock-id order, then buys; buys filling at one session are scaled pro rata when cash is short (need summed in stock-id order)
readings.fills_event: fills.csv has one row per order: event 'fill' or 'cancel'; side is the order's side (buy or sell)
readings.end_of_run: no fills at the final open mark; orders still pending then are listed in metrics.json and pending_at_end.csv, not as cancellations
readings.panel_start: engine.build_panel from the first review (its 60-day lookback before it)

benchmark_notes.universe_ew: v3's eligible list at each review, equal weight, rebalanced at every review (engine.run_universe_ew): same costs, dividends and forced exit
benchmark_notes.nifty_and_factor_indices: as v1 and v2: NSE's TRI; factor indices with the Clarification to A4's open rule and *_no_overnight
